$comment: The harness's list of known markers (Kanon plan 0012 §4.3): the only markers an expectation may look for in a comment, a review or a body. Each is a marker Kanon already writes for its own reasons, never one added for the tests (the no-leak rule). `pattern` is a regular expression matched against the text; `writtenBy` says where Kanon writes it. It lives under runner/, so a change to it is the Owner's to merge (docs/qa/escalation-paths.md).
